I farm maize here in Mbeya, and on this plot I will use some purchased fertilizer because maize responds well and I have some experience from past seasons. I will not use a heavy rate because inputs are costly, but I will still plant improved seed to get a better stand. I rely mostly on family work, though at my age I may need a few hired labor days for the heavier work. I will not irrigate, and I do not expect to use pesticide on this maize plot.
